en.headline: Two men charged over alleged HK$9 million procurement fraud
en.dek: A former systems engineer at Pacific Textiles and a relative appeared at West Kowloon Magistrates' Courts today after the ICAC charged them with fraud over IT purchases.
body: The Independent Commission Against Corruption has charged a former systems engineer of Pacific Textiles and a relative with fraud, alleging they hid conflicts of interest on about HK$9 million of information-technology purchases. The two men were due to appear at West Kowloon Magistrates' Courts on Wednesday, with prosecutors expected to seek a transfer to the District Court.

According to the commission, Leung Kam-chiu, 33, a former systems engineer in the company's information-technology department, faces four counts of fraud under the Theft Ordinance. Kong Cheuk-man, 34, sole proprietor of Shing Kwong Hang Trading, faces one fraud count. Both were granted bail.

The alleged offences took place between July 2021 and March 2023, when Leung helped source suppliers and obtain quotations for Pacific Textiles and related companies. The ICAC said he handled 48 purchase orders totalling about HK$9 million and represented that the goods came from four suppliers, including OX Technology, which it said he owned, and Shing Kwong Hang, which it said was run by his relative.

The commission said it began the inquiry after a corruption complaint. It alleged Leung bought the products on online platforms and resold them to the textile firm through the four suppliers at mark-ups of 6 to 8 percent, and that he never declared the conflicts to his employer. The two men have been charged and have not been convicted.

zh.headline: 互太前工程師涉隱瞞利益採購九百萬 廉署起訴兩人
zh.dek: 廉署起訴互太紡織前系統工程師及其親戚各欺詐罪，指他們在約九百萬元資訊科技採購中隱瞞利益衝突，兩人今於西九龍裁判法院應訊。
body: 廉政公署起訴互太紡織有限公司一名前系統工程師及其親戚，指他們涉嫌在約九百萬元資訊科技產品採購中隱瞞利益衝突，私下購貨後經供應商抬價轉售圖利。兩人獲准保釋，星期三在西九龍裁判法院應訊，控方稍後會申請將案件轉介區域法院答辯。
廉署表示，三十三歲的梁錦超曾任互太紡織資訊科技部系統工程師，被控四項欺詐罪，違反《盜竊罪條例》；三十四歲的江卓文是盛廣恆貿易有限公司獨資東主，被控其中一項欺詐罪。
控罪指，二零二一年七月至二零二三年三月期間，梁錦超負責為互太紡織及其同系公司物色供應商及索取報價。他其間處理四十八項採購，訂單總額約九百萬元，並涉嫌訖稱貨品由四間供應商供應，包括他獨資經營的OX Technology，以及由親戚江卓文經營的盛廣恆。
廉署接獲貪污投訴後展開調查，指梁錦超從未向公司申報利益衝突，並涉嫌在網上平台購入產品後，以該等供應商名義加價百分之六至八轉售予互太紡織。兩人已被起訴，案件尚未定罪。
